question: Who has been appointed as the chairman of Defence Research and Development Organisation and in August 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is Samir V Kamat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On August 26, 2022,** Dr Samir V. Kamat was named Chairman of the DRDO and Secretary of the Department of Defence R&D.**
 
• **Dr Kamat earned his PhD in Materials Science and Engineering from The Ohio State University, USA, in 1988** after completing his B. Tech. (Hons.) in Metallurgical Engineering at IIT-Kharagpur in 1985. **He joined the DRDO in 1989.**
 
• **Dr Kamat has led and directed a number of crucial material programmes at DRDO,** including the development of high-strength steels for naval ship hulls, high-temperature titanium alloys, and nickel base superalloy based components for aero-engines, the development of tungsten heavy alloys for kinetic energy penetrators, the development of fused silica radomes for missile seekers, and the development of armour solutions for personnel as well as combat vehicles and scout vehicles. These have been used in a number of the systems that the** DRDO laboratories** are creating.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Defence Research and Development Organisation**

 
 
• ​**The Ministry of Defence of the Government of India's Department of Defence Research and Development,** which has its **main office in Delhi, India, **and is responsible for the research and development of the military, is home to the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO),** the leading organisation in that department.
 
• It was created in 1958 by the **union of the Defence Science Organisation and the Technical Development Establishment and Directorate of Technical Development and Production of the Indian Ordnance Factories.**
 
• The **Defense Research & Development Service (DRDS)** was later established by **the Ministry of Defence in 1979** as a service for Group "A" Officers and Scientists, directly under its administrative jurisdiction.
